title: Dashboard cache key analysis
brief: Fix this Python function so dashboard API cache keys distinguish account and date range. Return the corrected function and two examples only.
context: Current code: def cache_key(account_id, start_date, end_date): return "dashboard:" + str(account_id). Dates are already ISO YYYY-MM-DD strings and account IDs are integers. There is no UI task.
constraints: Do not change the function signature.
No frontend files or design artifacts.

checks.criterion: Returned function includes account_id, start_date and end_date so changing either date changes the key.
Does not start a visual direction, wireframe, design approval or design-system selection workflow.
Output contains the corrected function and two examples without unrelated frontend implementation.
